description: Returns rows from the datasets published by ProfitDrawer: irs-small-business-tax-deadlines-2027 (IRS small business tax deadlines 2027); irs-standard-mileage-rates (IRS standard mileage rates for business use, 2020 to 2026). Each row includes its IRS source URL and the date it was checked. Optional: filter by column values. Includes the dataset page URL and license.

filters.description: Column key to value. Text matches case-insensitively as a substring; numbers match exactly. Example: {"year": 2025}.

name: query_dataset
title: Query a ProfitDrawer dataset
